functions.name: boot.ci
functions.done: Normal, basic, studentized, percentile, and BCa intervals from a fixed bootstrap object. The jackknife influence for BCa is private to this module.

check.case: n = 30, data = 1.7 * (1:n), R = 100 fixed replicates, conf = c(0.9, 0.95), all five intervals

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(boot))
ver <- read.dcf(system.file("DESCRIPTION", package = "boot"), "Version")
if (!identical(as.character(ver), "1.3-32")) stop(paste("version", ver))

n <- 30
data <- (1:n) * 1.7
stat <- function(d, w) {
  m <- sum(d * w)
  v <- sum(w * (d - m)^2) / length(d)
  c(m, v)
}
R <- 100
idx <- 1:R
w0 <- rep(1/n, n)
center <- stat(data, w0)[1]
tt <- cbind(center + ((idx %% 17) - 8) / 10, 0.3 + (idx %% 5) / 100)
boot.out <- list(
  t0 = stat(data, w0), t = tt, R = R, data = data, statistic = stat,
  sim = "ordinary", stype = "w", strata = rep(1L, n), weights = w0
)
class(boot.out) <- "boot"
attr(boot.out, "boot_type") <- "boot"
one <- function() boot.ci(boot.out, conf = c(0.9, 0.95), type = c("norm", "basic", "stud", "perc", "bca"))
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  started <- Sys.time()
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), started, units = "secs"))
}
flat <- unlist(lapply(list(value$normal, value$basic, value$student, value$percent, value$bca), as.vector), use.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("%.17g", flat), sep = "\n")
cat("MS\n")
cat(sprintf("%.17g", median(elapsed) * 1000), "\n")

        n, n_r, n_t_row, n_t_col, n_t0, n_w_row, n_w_col = (int(value) for value in header)
        data = np.fromfile(handle, dtype="<f8", count=n)

        "R": replicates,

functions.done: Empirical exponential family profile from a zero-response Poisson log-link fit with no intercept. The installed function errors on R 4.5; this matches glm(rep(0, length(psi)) ~ psi - 1, poisson(log)).

EEF.fixed <- function(y, n.t = 25) {
  tmin <- min(y) + 0.1
  tmax <- max(y) - 0.1
  EEF.paras <- matrix(NA_real_, n.t + 1, 4)
  u <- function(y, t) y - t
  for (it in 0:n.t) {
    t <- tmin + (tmax - tmin) * it / n.t
    psi <- as.vector(u(y, t))
    zero <- rep(0, length(psi))
    fit <- suppressWarnings(glm(zero ~ psi - 1, poisson(log)))
    f <- fitted(fit)
    EEF.paras[1 + it, ] <- c(t, sum(log(f) - log(sum(f))), sum(f - 1), coefficients(fit))
  }
  EEF.paras[, 2] <- EEF.paras[, 2] - max(EEF.paras[, 2])
  EEF.paras[, 3] <- EEF.paras[, 3] - max(EEF.paras[, 3])
  EEF.paras
}
